rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The guru instructs an attentive seated disciple beside the two crossed aranis.
rows.candidate_status: Exactly two generic seated figures: the older guru faces and instructs the attentive disciple beside the two crossed aranis; both logs remain distinct beneath a small fire and separate branch tangle. At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 medians: guru cheek (545,217) RGB (150,76,38) R-B 112; torso (410,320) (153,77,39) R-B 114; disciple cheek (1280,215) (152,80,43) R-B 109; torso (1295,315) (152,78,40) R-B 112. No readable text. Producer reviewed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Native and enlarged views show Brahma with four distinct heads (three faces and one rear head) and four attached arms holding lotus, rosary, water pot and blank leaf; his central face has knitted inner brows, widened attentive eyes and a subtly downturned mouth, reading as dignified unease at page scale. Bhattathiri has one head, two joined prayer hands and two legs tucked beneath his dhoti; Bhagwan has two arms and two visible open hands with thumb plus four fingers each. Skin-only 11x11 patch medians: Brahma cheek origin (235,135) RGB (196,138,83), R-B 113; Brahma arm origin (120,250) RGB (228,128,73), R-B 155; Bhattathiri cheek origin (685,483) RGB (212,111,64), R-B 148; Bhattathiri torso origin (642,590) RGB (226,124,71), R-B 155. These warm human skin samples exceed the plan target of about 120, peaking at R-B 155. Bhagwan blue skin-only samples: cheek origin (1355,210) RGB (99,149,217), B-R 118; torso origin (1370,350) RGB (76,139,188), B-R 112. No duplicate figures, visible extra limbs, readable text, beams or rays. Producer-reviewed pass with measured skin deviation disclosed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; art remains unapproved.

rows.scene: One connected tree holds both dream and waking; the reclining figure now has two clearly separated arms, with the second hand visible on the thigh.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining figure rests on the connected dream/waking tree with the existing mango cluster and waking-side lotus. The forehead is bare, with no tilak or paint; no earrings, necklaces, armlets or bangles are visible, and the figure wears plain dark hair in a simple topknot. Native and enlarged views show exactly two attached arms from distinct shoulders: one bends to support the head, the other runs separately along the side to a clearly visible thigh-resting hand; the forearms do not overlap or merge. The thigh hand shows a thumb and four fingers; the head-support hand shows four fingers, with its thumb partly occluded by head contact. One head, two connected legs, two feet, and five toes on each foot. Skin-only 11x11 medians: cheek origin (238,388) RGB (162,77,38), R-B 124; torso origin (360,454) RGB (115,46,19), R-B 96. The cheek sample is 4 above the plan guide; both patches read as warm brown, not orange. No second person, text, logo, watermark, rays or obvious artifact. Producer-reviewed pass with the measured cheek deviation disclosed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; art remains unapproved.
